purpose: Korean units for locale IDs the SWF looks up but WiiLink's gb_config_en.xml does not contain. On a Korean console, LocaleManager.getLocaleInfoByID returns these only when the loaded XML lacks the ID, so a service-provided unit always wins.
audit: Every getLocaleInfoByID argument in Gumball2.12.RC-1.swf (literal and 'prefix'+page) was compared with the 79 IDs of the WiiLink XML pinned 2026-10-28 (sha256 65245f0d...). Texts are KWCE's own; the screens' meaning was inferred from the SWF code (marked per entry).

txt_optin_4.message:
새 에피소드를 볼 수 있게 되어도
소식을 받지 않습니다.
txt_optin_4.evidence: [직접 확인] IntroScreen.onPressNo sets _optInPage=3 then advances to 4 and shows 'txt_optin_'+4 (v2 review: 'undefined' after 아니요). MessageOptInScreen uses txt_optin_5 for the same page, so the text is txt_optin_5's.

txt_late_1.evidence: [추정] IntroScreen late-start pages (DataController.isLateStart: first start after episode 1 ended).

txt_late_2.message:
방영이 끝난 에피소드는 열쇠나
수정 구슬을 사용해 볼 수 있습니다.

txt_reward_1.evidence: [직접 확인] crystal-ball reward pages (IntroScreen gift + VideoEndSequence videoReward=2, RewardSystem.addRewardTwo=cbs); [추정] wording.

txt_reward_3.message:
수정 구슬을 사용하면 아직 공개되지 않은
에피소드를 미리 볼 수 있습니다.
txt_reward_3.evidence: [직접 확인] EpisodeSynopsisScreen offers btn_use_crystal for LOCKED_FUTURE (and LOCKED_EXPIRED without keys).

txt_key_1.evidence: [직접 확인] key reward pages (VideoEndSequence videoReward=1, addRewardOne=keys); [추정] wording.

txt_key_3.message:
열쇠를 사용하면 방영이 끝난 에피소드를
24시간 동안 볼 수 있습니다.
txt_key_3.evidence: [직접 확인] LOCKED_EXPIRED uses keys first; WiiLink help key_2 states the 24 hours.

txt_channel_end_2.evidence: [직접 확인] page 2 is a yes/no dialog; yes advances to page 3 whose OK calls WiiSystem.deleteChannel() (ES_DeleteTitle in the DOL).

txt_channel_end_3.message:
커비 TV 채널을 삭제합니다.
확인을 누르면 삭제됩니다.

txt_channel_end_4.message:
커비 TV 채널을 삭제하지 않았습니다.
나중에 Wii 본체 설정의 데이터 관리에서
삭제할 수 있습니다.

txt_channel_end_5.message:
그동안 커비 TV 채널을
시청해 주셔서 감사합니다!
txt_channel_end_5.evidence: [직접 확인] page 5 is the closing message before returnToMenu.

txt_unlock_with_cb.message: 수정 구슬을 사용해 이 에피소드의 잠금을 푸시겠습니까?

not_added.txt_delay: DataController treats any non-empty txt_delay as a service interrupt notice (isInterrupt); adding it would show that screen.
not_added.txt_about_1: AboutScreen is the legal-text screen; no settings item in the WiiLink help_data opens it, and legal wording is not invented.
not_added.txt_spanish_*: Spanish-only language prompt, never shown for language 9.
not_added.btn_* without lookup: Buttons initialised through GumballButton.initFromXMLObject keep their own label when the ID is missing (guarded), so no 'undefined' is shown.
